verdict_reason: Accurate description of the address type page, tab and re-derived spike figures, but uses 'uses' and 'roles' for one concept and implies Place of origin itself is required.

todos.issue: One concept, two names: the README calls what an address is saved for 'a use' at :242 ('a save requires a use') and 'roles' at :260 ('An address holds roles from one tab only'), while the code posts roles: 'PLACE_OF_ORIGIN' (src/lib/address-book.js addAddressAnswers) and ins-frontend names the field roles. :93 also reads as though Place of origin itself is required ('ticking Place of origin, which a save requires'), when the save needs at least one role.
todos.fix: Must: the README names the concept with the one word the code uses (roles) at :93, :242 and :260, and states that a save needs at least one role rather than implying Place of origin is required. One way: ':93 ... and ticking Place of origin, since a save needs at least one role'; ':242 ... (a save needs at least one role)'.
